question: 2025年各收货地区、各季度的平均实付金额（客单价）是多少，每个组合的订单量如何？（仅列订单数不少于10的地点-季度组合）
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, quarter HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY o.region, quarter
notes: Task 13 评测失败自动沉淀；供 Task 14 分析
